answer: Commit a hash of the answer at submission, reveal the text at close, and pay only when the reveal matches and the panel holds nobody the worker recruited. Link two identities and both scores reset, so a shared funding edge costs more than it saves. One example: an operator funds ten keys from a single wallet, the echo of that transfer marks the cluster, the next epoch resets all ten, and the crystal of their standing is gone before the ocean of copies lands.
